hero.title: Trump tells Congress ceasefire means he does not need their approval for Iran war
hero.summary: The president writes that hostilities "have terminated" because of the ceasefire, arguing he does not need congressional authorisation.

items.title: Trump to raise tariffs on cars, trucks from EU to 25%
items.summary: President Donald Trump said he's raising tariffs on cars and trucks from the European Union to 25%, claiming the bloc was not complying with its trade agreement with the US.

items.title: Meta buys robotics startup to bolster its humanoid AI ambitions
items.summary: Meta bought humanoid startup Assured Robot Intelligence to beef up its AI models for robots, the company said.

items.title: At least 12 killed in latest Israeli attacks on Lebanon
items.summary: Israel's strikes continue, with more than 2,600 killed since March 2, despite an ongoing ceasefire.

items.title: Oscars says AI actors, writing cannot win awards
items.summary: The academy that controls the Oscars on Friday issued new award eligibility requirements around the use of artificial intelligence in film.
